name: @visuelconcept/wui-alarms
description: Alarms — standalone WinCC OA WebUI page (/alarms): the plant's alarm list, live (standing alarms) or over an archived period, with the unacknowledged counter, the P1–P4 severity bands as a filter, the EEMUA-191 flood histogram, the recurring bad actors, free-text search, server-side-style sort/paging and acknowledge. The whole view is the shared <wui-alarm-view> component from @visuelconcept/wui-alarms-core, so the same view embeds in other pages (Machine Fleet machine dashboard).
